title: KASA Core Intent
description: Strict contract the intent parser must emit. The parser fills action/amount/transcript; it NEVER executes. Per K05 Decision 3, the RECIPIENT is resolved ON-DEVICE by the app against the local trusted-payees list (server no longer receives contacts): the server returns recipient.raw, the app fills matched_contact and number. Execution is gated on explicit user confirmation.

amount.description: Amount in GHS. null when not applicable/not captured.

needs_confirmation.description: Always true for money/data actions. App must speak+display a summary and get explicit approval before the USSD engine runs.
